howEachLeverIsBuilt.a: the mandate status already reaches the core as `MandateRecord.providerStatus` (printed on the plan letter), and `PlanService.start` already calls `Mandates.find`; the shortcut is one comparison in the service (and a `charge` on the same port answering the raw payment status), the clean path a new `MandateStanding` type, a field on the record, an adapter mapping, and a `collect` on the `Charges` port answering the existing `ChargeOutcome`
howEachLeverIsBuilt.b: the steps say "mandate is in status mandate_active", the six other mandate statuses, "status pending_submission or submitted" and "status collection_failed"
